scope: separate the four GTK2 arrow glyphs from the surrounding 15x15 stepper cell

method.description: Compare registered RGB pixels in each 15x15 historical/reference cell. Classify glyph pixels only where the corresponding generated 11x11 GTK2 arrow asset has nonzero alpha, centered at offset (2,2). No per-pixel registration optimization is used.

conclusion: For all four directions in this GTK2 pipeline capture, every opaque arrow glyph pixel matches the corresponding SR10.4 reference pixel. The visible cell-level differences in R334/R335 are outside the arrow alpha masks and belong to the stepper relief/edge region. The measured arrow silhouette is 11x11 in all directions; the original concern about a horizontally shortened glyph is not reproduced by the current pipeline output.
limits: This confirms the current generated GTK2 pipeline, not pixels in an already-open production GTK2 application.
It does not prove native live VM appearance, pressed/disabled states, or manual acceptance.
It does not resolve the remaining cell-relief edge differences; do not change arrow assets to address them.
next: Keep I167 on GTK2. Compare the remaining cell-edge pixels against a fresh VM image once physically awake; separately validate a GTK2 application after it reloads the installed recipe.
